fieldData.main-content:
Access between the wider crypto economy and Radix just got significantly smoother.

We are thrilled to announce that the XRD<>eXRD Hyperlane route has expanded to include Base. This new route unlocks a major milestone for the ecosystem: users in supported geographies can now buy and sell eXRD directly via Coinbase.

This update opens the door for millions of potential users to access eXRD using USD, removing complex barriers to entry and providing a seamless on-ramp to the Radix ecosystem.

Buy and Sell eXRD on Coinbase

By leveraging the BASE network, eXRD is now accessible through Coinbase’s trading interface. This means millions of users can now easily buy and sell eXRD, allowing users to easily buy and sell with USD and USDC. You can learn more about the details on trading via Coinbase DEX here: https://www.coinbase.com/en-gb/dex

To support this new influx of access, initial liquidity has been seeded on Uniswap on BASE, paired with USDC. Whether you are entering via Coinbase or trading on-chain, deep liquidity ensures a smooth experience for all participants. Community liquidity providers may also wish to support liquidity on BASE with eXRD to earn a share of fees.

How to Get Started

To Buy/Sell: Head over to Coinbase (in supported regions) to access eXRD directly via Coinbase interfaces, such as their mobile app.

To Bridge: If you already hold assets and wish to move between chains:

  1. Go to Astrolescent or Hyperlane Nexus.
  2. Select Base and Radix as your source/destination, and XRD/eXRD as your assets.
  3. Connect your wallet and bridge!

Token Contract Details

For users verifying assets or adding tokens to their self-custody wallets on Base, the official eXRD contract address is:

0x574134917E3d78705Ed865b6EC58Fa67F95F9a7E

What’s Next

By expanding into Base and making eXRD available to millions of Coinbase users, we are ensuring that the path to Radix is shorter, faster, and more accessible than ever before.

Combined with the ease of a permissionless bridge for assets into the Radix ecosystem, this minimizes friction for users looking to utilize the maturing DeFi ecosystem building on Radix.
fieldData.name: eXRD Now Accessible via Coinbase DEX
